name: Irish Championship 2018
information: Irish Championship 2018 will be held in Lucan Community College on the 14th & 15th of July. The room will be the gym. Ciarán Beahan is organising the competition with David Lim acting as delegate. There will be a competitor limit of 100 competitors and the registration fees are as follows: * 1-4 events €10 * 5-8 events €15 * 9-13 events €20 13 events will be held at this years championships, all but feet, fmc, 4bld, 5bld, and multi bld.
